# An .Rmd chapter

Its extension is spelled with a capital letter, so the test on it has to
compare case-insensitively or refuse a chapter this route reads perfectly
well: [Escutcheon]{.index}.

A second mark, into the book's other index, so that index has a member from a
chapter the route accepts and is not a section holding one refused term:
[Ferrule]{.index index="aside"}.
